A '''battle''' occurred on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].

==The battle==
The battle resulted in a costly [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] victory, but, along with the battles of [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Felucia]], and [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Boz Pity]], led to the fall of the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]], an area known to house numerous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] industrial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="Warfare" />
